name: crypto-utils
description: Offline cryptographic and encoding utilities — hashing, HMAC, JWT decoding/verification, secure token and password generation, and base64/base64url/hex/URL encode/decode. Runs fully local with no network or credentials, using only the Python standard library.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: crypto.hash
tools.description: Compute a cryptographic hash (hex digest) of some data. Provide either plain text (hashed as UTF-8) or base64-encoded bytes.

text.description: Text to hash (encoded as UTF-8). Ignored if dataBase64 is given.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes to hash instead of text.

tools.name: crypto.hmac
tools.description: Compute an HMAC (hex) of a message with a secret key.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for the HMAC (default sha256).

tools.name: crypto.jwt_decode
tools.description: Decode a JWT into its header and payload (no verification required). If a secret is provided and the algorithm is HS256/HS384/HS512, the signature is verified with a constant-time compare and 'valid' is returned. Asymmetric algorithms (RS/ES/PS) are decoded but not verified.

secret.description: Optional shared secret to verify an HS256/384/512 signature.

algorithm.description: Expected algorithm (default HS256). Used for signature verification.

tools.name: crypto.generate_token
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically secure random token.

length.description: Number of random bytes of entropy (default 32).

tools.name: crypto.generate_password
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically secure random password with a mix of character classes.

tools.name: crypto.encode
tools.description: Encode UTF-8 text into base64, base64url, hex, or URL (percent) encoding.

tools.name: crypto.decode
tools.description: Decode base64, base64url, hex, or URL (percent) encoded text back into a UTF-8 string.
